snippet.title: Dead Reset - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Trapped in a terrifying death-loop, surgeon Cole Mason is kidnapped and brought to an underwater facility, forced to operate on a patient to extract an evolving parasitic horror. Dead Reset is a blood-soaked interactive horror, where each death brings you closer to the truth.

Out now on PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S and Nintendo Switch.
Play the demo on PC, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Play Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1346840/Dead_Reset/

Developed by Wales Interactive and Dark Rift Horror.
